event.name: Ainsley's Taste of the Bahamas
event.description: Chef Ainsley Harriott explores the vibrant flavours, local producers, markets and unique dishes of the island nation located in the Atlantic Ocean. He kicks off his island adventures with the comfort foods at the heart of Bahamian cooking, from 'chicken in da bag' at Bamboo Shack to learning to put his peas before his rice with chef Tevin Kemp. Then he wraps things up in his beachside kitchen with prawn and coconut fritters served with a pickled coconut slaw

event.name: Nations Championship
event.description: England v Australia (Kick-off 3.10pm). Mark Pougatch presents all the action from both teams' opening match in the Northern Hemisphere Series, held at Allianz Stadium Twickenham. England bounced back from a defeat at the hands of South Africa in the Southern Series with victories over Fiji and Argentina. Australia comfortably claimed their first win of the series against Italy after losses to Ireland and France. With analysis from Ugo Monye and George Gregan, pitchside reports by Topsy Ojo, and commentary from Nick Mullins, David Flatman and Ben Kay

event.name: Long Lost Family
event.description: Davina McCall and Nicky Campbell present the stories of two women searching for siblings. Tracey Boyle had children of her own before she learned of her brother's existence when her mother finally confided in her that her first-born son was prised from her hands at the age of 16. Liz Allward was adopted as a baby but always had a feeling that she had a biological sister and has longed to meet her since being proved right

event.name: The Debrief with Dan and ROG
event.description: Claire Thomas is joined by Dan Biggar and Japan coach Eddie Jones to pick over all the talking points from the opening weekend of the autumn instalment of the Nations Championship. England were desperate to start their campaign with a win against Australia, Scotland were aiming to beat New Zealand for the very first time, Wales were targeting a home win against Japan and Ireland faced a tricky test against Argentina in Dublin
